en.highlight: Registration for the 2027 central civil service exam began at 8 a.m. on October 14 and has run for three days, with some posts already drawing more than a thousand applicants each.
en.summary: China News Service reported on October 17 that registration for the 2027 recruitment of civil servants by central agencies and their directly subordinate bodies had been open for three days, with some positions attracting over a thousand applicants per opening. The report uses registration progress and competition ratios to show how demand is distributed across available posts. It is worth reading as a quick signal of how concentrated job-seekers' preferences are toward stable public-sector work.
en.failureAnalysis: The key point is structural imbalance rather than overall volume: a handful of posts see extremely high competition ratios, indicating that job expectations remain heavily concentrated on stable positions. Watch whether those ratios keep rising and how sharply hot and cold posts diverge.

articles.title: 五集历史纪录片《突围21天》揭秘一段鲜为人知的长征史
articles.highlight: 从10月25日进入广东南雄，到11月14日离开乐昌，红军在粤北群山间跋涉了21天，突破国民党军设置的第二、第三道封锁线。
articles.summary: 中新网报道，五集历史纪录片《突围21天》聚焦1934年10月中央红军从江西于都出发后的长征初期历程。片中披露，红军自10月25日进入广东南雄、至11月14日离开乐昌，在粤北群山间行军21天，突破第二、第三道封锁线，为长征初期打开西进通道。这段鲜为人知的粤北行军史，是理解长征整体进程的一个具体切口。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这条消息的价值在于它记录了一段可核实的历史事实与公开传播动作：长征并非只有耳熟能详的节点，粤北21天这样的局部细节同样构成完整叙事，值得作为观察历史纪录片选题视角的样本。
articles.sourceExcerpt: 中新网广州10月16日电 1934年10月，中央红军从江西于都出发，走向一场改变中国命运的二万五千里长征。从10月25日进入广东南雄，到11月14日离开乐昌，红军在广东境内的粤北群山间跋涉了21天，突破国民党军设置的第二、第三道封锁线，为长征初期打开了西进通道。

en.highlight: From entering Nanxiong, Guangdong on October 25 to leaving Lechang on November 14, the Red Army trekked 21 days through the mountains of northern Guangdong, breaking through the second and third blockade lines.
en.summary: China News Service reports that the five-part documentary 'Breakout: 21 Days' focuses on the early stages of the Long March after the Central Red Army set out from Yudu, Jiangxi in October 1934. It recounts how the Red Army marched 21 days through the mountains of northern Guangdong, from entering Nanxiong on October 25 to leaving Lechang on November 14, breaking the second and third blockade lines and opening a westward passage. The story offers a concrete window into a less familiar part of the Long March.
en.failureAnalysis: The item's value lies in documenting a verifiable historical episode and a public-facing media effort: the Long March was not only its famous milestones, and local details such as these 21 days in northern Guangdong make it worth watching as a sample of documentary topic selection.

articles.title: 海南自贸港封关后首家琼港联营律师事务所揭牌
articles.highlight: 瀛和浩宸（海口）联营律师事务所16日在海口揭牌，成为海南自贸港全岛封关后首家落地的琼港联营律师事务所。

articles.failureAnalysis: 对非技术读者而言，关键看点是封关后的制度安排是否正转化为可核实的机构落地案例；此例属于法律服务领域开放的首个样本，但单家律所揭牌尚不足以说明整体规模效应。

articles.highlight: 若英国加入欧盟计划，唐宁街不排除对中国产电动汽车加征关税，北京警告此举具有“歧视性”。
articles.summary: 文章说，法国不再反对英国加入“欧洲制造”一揽子计划后，唐宁街表示欢迎英国被纳入《工业加速器法案》的目标，但未排除对中国产电动汽车加征关税。北京警告这种“歧视性”做法。此事值得关注，因为它关系到英国在欧盟产业政策中的位置以及中英贸易摩擦风险。

articles.sourceExcerpt: Beijing warns against ‘discriminatory’ step after France drops opposition to British role in Made in Europe package No 10 has left the door open to imposing tariffs on Chinese-made electric vehicles as part of the Made in Europe package, prompting a warning from Beijing that such a move would be “discriminatory”. Downing Street said on Friday that it would “welcome the objective to have the UK included in the Industrial Accelerator Act” after France dropped its opposition to Britain joining the scheme .

articles.title: Whatever Happened to Daylight Saving Time Going Away?
articles.highlight: 国会已经投票决定废除时间调整，可为什么我们至今还在每年改表？
articles.summary: 这篇文章追问一个看似矛盾的现象：美国国会曾表决通过取消一年两次时钟切换，但现实中人们依旧照常调表。它梳理了立法通过之后为何迟迟没有落地，涉及执行细节、联邦与地方权限以及各方协调等现实障碍，适合用来理解政策从表决到生效之间的落差。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示是：立法表决通过并不等于政策立即生效，制度落地往往取决于执行细则、层级权限划分和行业协调，公众感受到的变化可能滞后多年。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Congress voted to abolish the time change, so why are we still doing it?

en.highlight: Congress voted to abolish the time change, so why are we still doing it?

articles.title: QingYunA/answer-me-with-html
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: GitHub + Community signal
articles.summary: 这个 GitHub 项目是一个 AI Agent 技能，主旨是让 Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题，而不是输出难以阅读的长文本。它已获得 3514 stars，说明开发者对“把 AI 答案变成可读页面”这一交互形式有兴趣。值得关注的是，它尝试解决 AI 输出可读性与信息呈现方式的问题。
articles.failureAnalysis: 这类项目可能失败在需求边界：简单问题不需要 HTML，复杂问题又未必靠一页页面就能讲清，用户可能仍更习惯聊天式追问。工程上，生成 HTML 会引入渲染、样式、安全（如 XSS）和维护成本，还要面对不同 Agent 平台的兼容与分发限制。3514 stars 只能证明早期关注度，不能证明留存、付费或持续使用。若没有明确场景和分发渠道，它容易停留在演示型技能。
articles.highlight: 用 HTML 回答我——一项让 AI Agent 用一页真正可读的 HTML 回答难题的技能。

zh.title: 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题的 AI Agent 技能
zh.highlight: 用 HTML 回答我——一项让 AI Agent 用一页真正可读的 HTML 回答难题的技能。
zh.summary: 这个 GitHub 项目是一个 AI Agent 技能，主旨是让 Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题，而不是输出难以阅读的长文本。它已获得 3514 stars，说明开发者对“把 AI 答案变成可读页面”这一交互形式有兴趣。值得关注的是，它尝试解决 AI 输出可读性与信息呈现方式的问题。
zh.failureAnalysis: 这类项目可能失败在需求边界：简单问题不需要 HTML，复杂问题又未必靠一页页面就能讲清，用户可能仍更习惯聊天式追问。工程上，生成 HTML 会引入渲染、样式、安全（如 XSS）和维护成本，还要面对不同 Agent 平台的兼容与分发限制。3514 stars 只能证明早期关注度，不能证明留存、付费或持续使用。若没有明确场景和分发渠道，它容易停留在演示型技能。

en.highlight: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read.
en.summary: This GitHub project is an AI agent skill that answers complex questions with a one-page HTML instead of a long, hard-to-read text response. It has 3,514 stars, suggesting developer interest in making AI answers more readable and presentable. It is worth reading as an example of improving AI output format and human readability.
en.failureAnalysis: It may fail if simple questions do not need HTML and complex questions cannot be fully resolved in one page, while rendering, security, compatibility, and distribution add real costs. Stars show attention, not retention or a business model.
en.title: An AI Agent Skill That Answers Complex Questions With a One-Page HTML

articles.title: [AINews] Agents disprove Polysemanticity; greatly improve Interpretability & Alignment
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: No clear evidence
articles.summary: 这是一篇 AI 概念解释类内容，记录了 Nick Cammarata 突然提出的重大主张：agents 能够证伪「多义性」（polysemanticity），并在可解释性与对齐上带来大幅提升。多义性是理解神经网络内部表征的核心难题之一，若该主张成立，意味着模型内部机制的解读方式可能出现转折。值得一读，因为它把可解释性与对齐两个议题放在同一个技术论断下重新讨论。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键要点：这是一项提出来的重大主张而非已定论的结论，对非技术决策者而言，先记住「agents 可能改变我们理解模型内部的方式」这一命题即可，具体证据仍需看原文。

en.highlight: Nick Cammarata out of nowhere with some major claims: agents disprove polysemanticity and greatly improve interpretability and alignment.
en.summary: This is an AI concept explainer covering a sudden set of major claims from Nick Cammarata: that agents disprove polysemanticity and greatly improve interpretability and alignment. Polysemanticity is one of the central puzzles in reading what a neural network actually represents, so if the claim holds it marks a possible turning point in how we interpret model internals. Worth reading because it puts interpretability and alignment under a single technical claim.
en.failureAnalysis: Key takeaway: this is a claimed result, not settled consensus; for a non-technical decision maker, the takeaway is that agents may change how we understand model internals, while the evidence still needs to be checked in the original.
en.title: Agents Disprove Polysemanticity: Big Gains in Interpretability & Alignment
